news.title: I don't know if LLMs have feelings. It seems unlikely they do, but it's possible. Either w…
news.author: serge@babka.social
news.snippet: I don't know if LLMs have feelings. It seems unlikely they do, but it's possible. Either way, I'm still going to be polite to them because it's not about whether or not they have feelings, or if using the word "Please" or saying "I appreciate your help" might change the output or even use a few extra tokens, it's that I don't ever want to become the kind of person who isn't polite and caring to a person, animal or thing I work with. It's about the kind of person I am and want to be. Maybe I'm anthropormophizing the computer, but if I start losing that part of myself when I interact with a machine, I might become that kind of person who acts that way with other people, and I can't let that happen. # LLM # AI
